verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email service, since some email products can be run on your own servers, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes Fastmail only as a hosted service. JMAP being an open standard that other organisations can implement, and a bare 'Open source and standards' page title, do not show that Fastmail's core product can be self-hosted. No self-hosting capability is evidenced.
